verdict.rationale: Galileo's logging docs say it captures every session, trace, and span. Spans that share a trace ID are joined into one trace, even across agents running in different processes via OTel. The Python SDK's @log decorator logs spans, and cookbooks show multi-agent LangGraph tracing with session-level metrics. missing for 10: explicit documentation of parent/child span nesting for agent steps, independent or hands-on corroboration of the session/thread grouping.
